findings.message: testability is manual/skip — new definitions must ship testability:auto (manual is decided after execution).

Build the COMPLETE prerequisite chain in dependsOn (the list of APIs QA must call first). FKs to trace: the referenced resources. For EACH: add the CREATE endpoint, any PUBLISH/ACTIVATE/APPROVE endpoint that makes the row usable, and any SUB-RESOURCE it needs (e.g. rates), in order; set each FK value to {cache:...} from its producer. Do NOT mark manual — build the chain (a NOT NULL FK to a non-seeded row is the #1 cause of 500s).
